workflow_scope: New PRIVATE repository only; no Pages

limits: Literal Markdown, HTML, CSS URLs and local JavaScript imports only
Dynamic runtime references and real external access remain separate checks
No browser execution, code execution or scientific rerun

archive_scope: Separate named recovery ZIPs and complete historical science archive outside primary tree
manifest_self_sha: Held outside kit; MANIFEST does not hash itself
read_only_limit: File attribute is not isolation from processes with the same permissions
